test_objective:
Check that a notification is sent in normalized format when a relationship is deleted via NGSI-LD Null
in a Merge Entity operation and attributeDeleted notification trigger is configured for this specific relationship

test_cases.name: 046_22_10_01 Check that a notification is sent with matching entity when deleting via Merge Entity operation
test_cases.doc: Delete a relationship via Merge Entity operation and check the received notification
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entity_id}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Merge Entity and
    Query Parameter: entity_id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: entity_filename set to 'fragmentEntities/ngsild-null/building-null-relationship.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: context set to ''
}

test_cases.name: 046_22_10_02 Check that a notification is sent with matching entity when deleting via Update Attributes operation
test_cases.doc: Delete a relationship via Update Attributes operation and check the received notification
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'ngsild-null/null-relationship.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}

test_cases.name: 046_22_10_03 Check that a notification is sent with matching entity when deleting via Partial Attribute Update operation
test_cases.doc: Delete a relationship via Update Partial Attribute Update operation and check the received notification
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Request Partial Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: entityId set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: AttributeId set to 'locatedAt' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'ngsild-null/null-relationship-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
